title: A menu in the console
description:
Move a highlight through a menu with arrow keys and choose with Enter.

```
> New game
  Load game
  Options
  Quit
keys: down, down, enter -> chose "Options"
```
hints: `selected = (selected + 1) % size` goes down with wrapping; up is `(selected + size - 1) % size` (lesson 5.09).
On a real console, `SetConsoleCursorPosition` redraws in place instead of printing a new menu each time.
requirements: A list of items and a selected index that wraps around at both ends.
Keys come from a list (so it runs anywhere); on Windows they would come from `ReadConsoleInput`.
Redraw the whole menu after each key.
stretch: Add a disabled item that the highlight skips.
